run_flops_benchmark_cli: run the flops benchmark CLI to calculate FLOPS and speed for embedder and extractor models
calculate_model_flops: calculate FLOPS, MACs, and parameter count for an Embedder or Extractor model using calflops
benchmark_model_speed: benchmark forward pass, interpolation, and normalization timing for a model on a data loader
get_data_loader: create a DataLoader with FakeData for benchmarking embedder or extractor models
save_benchmark_results: save benchmark results as a CSV file with per-image and per-batch timing metrics
